texts.Die GreedyModCollection (GMC) ist eine v: The GreedyModCollection (GMC) is a community-driven mod collection for Life is Feudal: Your Own. It combines game assets, modifications, tools and community-created content from various sources into one collection, distributed through a custom patcher hosted via Cloudflare and installed in conjunction with Steam.
texts.BitBox Ltd. – Life is Feudal: Your Own: BitBox Ltd. – Life is Feudal: Your Own
texts.Die GreedyModCollection wird als gemeins: The GreedyModCollection is distributed as a combined community mod collection. Installation and updates are handled through a dedicated patcher that retrieves the relevant files from infrastructure hosted via Cloudflare and integrates them with the Steam installation of the game.
texts.Die Aufnahme von Inhalten Dritter in die: The inclusion of third-party content in the GMC does not transfer ownership of that content to the GMC project or its maintainers. Individual components remain subject to their respective copyright notices, licence terms and distribution restrictions.
texts.Die GreedyModCollection ist ein unabhäng: The GreedyModCollection is an independent community project. Unless explicitly stated otherwise, it is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially associated with BitBox Ltd., the original game developers, or the creators and maintainers of the third-party modifications listed above.
texts.Alle Namen, Marken und Materialien Dritt: All third-party names, trademarks and materials are acknowledged solely to identify their respective owners, creators and sources.
texts.Bitte nenne in deiner Nachricht das betr: Please identify the relevant asset, modification or material in your message so that the matter can be reviewed.
texts.Die GMC erhebt keinen Anspruch auf die u: The GMC does not claim original authorship or ownership of third-party content included in the collection. All copyrights, trademarks and other intellectual property rights in that content remain with their respective owners and creators.
texts.BitBox Ltd. wird als ursprünglicher Entw: BitBox Ltd. is credited as the original developer of the game. Promotional images and other visual materials taken from the official press kit remain the property of BitBox Ltd.
texts.Ausgewählte Modelle, Assets und Texturen: Selected models, assets and textures originating from Life is Feudal are included in the GreedyModCollection (GMC). They remain the property of their respective creators and rights holders. Their inclusion does not imply endorsement by, or a licence from, those rights holders.
texts.Die GMC enthält den Lifxtended-Launcher,: The GMC incorporates the Lifxtended launcher, the Tradepost mod and additional modifications associated with the Lifxtended project. They remain the property of their authors and are subject to the authors' licence terms.
texts.Modifikationen von SF Mods sind in der G: Modifications originating from SF Mods are included in the GMC. They remain the property of their authors and are subject to the authors' licence terms.
texts.Ausgewählte Assets, Texturen und Symbole: Selected assets, textures and icons originating from Jorvik are included in the GMC. They remain the property of their authors and are subject to the authors' licence terms.
texts.Ausgewählte 3D-Modelle, Texturen und Sym: Selected 3D models, textures and icons originating from EKR are included in the GMC. They remain the property of their authors and are subject to the authors' licence terms.
texts.Dieser Hinweis nennt die Quellen von Mat: This notice credits the sources of third-party material and does not grant any rights in it. The GMC project aims to respect the intellectual property rights of all original creators and rights holders.
texts.Wenn du Rechteinhaber bist und möchtest,: If you are a rights holder and want material credited differently or removed from the GreedyModCollection, please contact the project team and the request will be reviewed promptly:
